description: This file defines the JobTitleMenuConfigurator class responsible for configuring menu items related to job titles in the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and uses traits for module screen helper functions. The class contains a configure method that overrides the current screen to 'viewJobTitleList'.

classes.name: JobTitleMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring the menu for job titles within the OrangeHRM admin plugin, implementing the MenuConfigurator interface and overriding screen views.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewJobTitleList' and returns null.
